72084478.title: Joy_Laking
72084478.extract:
Joy Laking is a renowned Canadian visual artist and author based in Nova Scotia. She was born in Owen Sound, Ontario in 1950 and grew up in a family with a strong artistic background. Laking graduated from the University of Guelph with a major in Fine Art and has been a professional artist living and working in Nova Scotia since 1972. Her work is characterized by representational realism and has been displayed in Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Ontario, and Quebec, including the Art Gallery of Nova Scotia.

Laking's unique white-on-white technique and winter paintings reveal a preoccupation with reflection and ongoing experimentation with her artistic process. She has won prestigious awards, including the Queen's Diamond Jubilee Medal and the Cobequid Arts Council Lifetime Achievement Award. Her paintings have been exhibited all over the province and the world, and she has had national solo exhibitions. Joy Laking's art is driven by her need to encapsulate the beauty of Nova Scotia-its huge, ever-changing skies and tides, coastal cliffs, rocky shores, and tranquil marshes. She has been painting Nova Scotia's natural landscapes and towns for 44 years, and to her, all of her paintings "sing."

The impact of the April 2020 mass shooting in Nova Scotia affected Laking's career for some time. She has spoken about the darkness that followed the tragedy and how it left her in a depression like none she has ever experienced before. However, she continues to use her art as a form of healing and to help others cope with the tragedy. Laking's art and her response to the shooting have provided comfort and solace to many in the community.
